## Working: Array Representation

Since A is the root node, we will insert it at the first position (index 1 in this case).

![Inserting the Root Node (A) into the Array Representation](data:image/png;base64,)

B is the left child node of A :

```text
B: 2 * 1 = 2
```

C is the right child node of A:

```text
C: 2 * 1 + 1 = 3
```

![Calculating Positions of Child Nodes (B and C) in the Array Representation](data:image/png;base64,)

D and E are the child nodes of B.

Since B is at index 2:

```text
D: 2 * 2 = 4
E: 2 * 2 + 1 = 5
```

![Calculating Positions of Child Nodes (D and E) of Node B](data:image/png;base64,)

Similarly, F and G are the child nodes of C.

```python
F: 2 * 3 = 6
G: 2 * 3 + 1 = 7
```

![Calculating Positions of Child Nodes (F and G) of Node C](data:image/png;base64,)
